newsitem.title: LEBANON: SOLIDERE shares mixed on Beirut Stock Exchange.
newsitem.headline: SOLIDERE shares mixed on Beirut Stock Exchange.

text.p: SOLIDERE shares were mixed on Wednesday on reduced turnover.
A shares rose to $114 from Tuesday's $113 and B shares held steady at $118.
Turnover fell to 6,823 shares from 8,222 and value was $785,613.875 from $939,822.
There was no trade in the four other listed companies: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic. None of the shares were traded in the last two weeks.
The LISPI stock index rose 0.13 percent to 84.61 and the BLOM stock index was up 0.33 percent to 985.72.
